codeNames.name: Provisional Agent 000
codeNames.meaning: A card the house keeps back. Useful, and not yet played.

codeNames.name: Executive-in-Waiting
codeNames.meaning: Archer is waiting for someone. Everyone under him waits too.

codeNames.name: Stowaway
codeNames.meaning: You came aboard without asking, and he liked that.

codeNames.name: Ember
codeNames.meaning: A small, measurable quantity of heat.

codeNames.name: Probationer Ceres
codeNames.meaning: Commanders are planets. Ceres is not quite one.

codeNames.name: The Seventh Sage
codeNames.meaning: A seat that has stood empty since the Sages broke.

codeNames.name: The Guest of Honor
codeNames.meaning: The one person he wants to save without charging.

codeNames.name: Numbskull Number One
codeNames.meaning: It is the highest compliment he has.

codeNames.name: The Deputy Director
codeNames.meaning: A white coat, and a door that locks behind you.

codeNames.name: Junior Executive, Future Planning
codeNames.meaning: A department of one, invented for the player.

codeNames.name: Fulu Squad
codeNames.meaning: The faintest star in the constellation. Still in it.

ladder.hideout: People stop talking when you come in.

gives: A Grunt runner carries one item for you

ladder.hideout: People ask you what you think.
gives: You are told the real plan, not the memo
One officer's signature tool can be borrowed per job

ladder.hideout: The Leader's door is left open.
gives: The Leader asks you one honest question

rise.name: Rise
rise.text: The team keeps you. You hold the post longer than their Executives did.

throne.name: Take the Throne
throne.text: You take the chair. The officers choose, and the first three orders are yours.

turn.name: Turn
turn.text: You break the plan from the inside. The team will remember it in every region after this one.
